title: Distribution Matching Evolutionary Algorithms for Rare Event Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.03833v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A novel discovery is one which is both useful and surprising: a generative model's output is a useful discovery if it has a low probability of being generated (it's surprising) and a high reward (it's useful). Global optimization can directly increase the probability of sampling high rewards but typically requires updating model weights. Such gradient based optimization is expensive and bars using capable closed-source models. Instead, modern search methods for discovery sacrifice the global target, and use evolutionary algorithms with local reward maximizing objectives, permitting the search to focus only on high probability samples. In this paper, we interpret various evolutionary algorithms as approximate Markov Chain Monte Carlo, an optimization-free method to sample from complex distributions. translated_title: 用于稀有事件采样的分布匹配进化算法
translated_abstract: 一项新颖的发现应当既有用又令人惊讶：如果生成模型的输出被生成的概率较低（令人惊讶）且奖励较高（有用），那么它就是一项有用的发现。全局优化可以直接提高采样到高奖励结果的概率，但通常需要更新模型权重。这种基于梯度的优化成本高昂，并且无法使用强大的闭源模型。相反，现代用于发现的搜索方法放弃了全局目标，转而使用以局部奖励最大化为目标的进化算法，使搜索只专注于高概率样本。在本文中，我们将各种进化算法解释为近似的马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗方法，这是一种无需优化的、从复杂分布中采样的方法。这一解释使我们能够开发出分布匹配进化算法（DME），这是一类从……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将进化算法解释为近似马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗采样方法，据此提出分布匹配进化算法（DME），为一类无需梯度更新模型权重即可从生成模型中高效采样稀有且高奖励事件的搜索方法。
en_tdlr: This paper interprets evolutionary algorithms as approximate Markov Chain Monte Carlo and proposes Distribution Matching Evolutionary Algorithms (DME), a class of gradient-free search methods for efficiently sampling rare, high-reward events from generative models.
